integrity: The equilibrium and characteristic coefficients are reconstructed from the printed equations with exact rational arithmetic. The source's reported values are treated as published evidence, not silently corrected; the distinction between the printed coefficient \(0.48\) and the Table 1/general-model coefficient \(0.38\) is preserved.
scientific_limitations: The proof treats equation (5.1) literally and the case \(\tau_2=0\). It establishes the first linear characteristic crossing but does not recompute the nonlinear first Lyapunov coefficient at the corrected crossing or repair the source's other delay cases.
title: Rank-one delay correction for the Yang–Zhang SIQRS threshold
